issue.summary: Sanctions / watchlist hit (OFAC SDN (possible match)) with active spend

plan.diagnosis: Schwaben Packaging GmbH triggered an OFAC SDN possible match with USD 64,508 active spend across 4 plants in Oracle NetSuite and SAP ECC 6.0 systems. The supplier operates from Germany with a risk score of 59.1, requiring immediate spend suspension and compliance verification to avoid regulatory penalties and reputational damage.

remedy_steps.step: Immediately block all purchase orders and payments; implement posting block in SAP ECC 6.0 (LFA1/LFB1) and set vendor status to inactive in Oracle NetSuite
remedy_steps.owner: Procurement Operations Lead & ERP System Admin

remedy_steps.step: Escalate to Legal/Compliance to conduct full OFAC screening validation, obtain official determination on match accuracy, and document findings with Treasury OFAC if necessary
Identify all open POs and contracts across 4 affected plants; quantify inventory at risk and initiate communications with internal stakeholders on supply continuity plans
Source and qualify 2-3 alternative packaging suppliers from low-risk countries; expedite onboarding with compressed due diligence focused on sanctions screening
Execute supplier transition plan, transfer USD 64,508 annual spend to approved alternative suppliers, and terminate all agreements with Schwaben Packaging GmbH
Update master data in SAP ECC 6.0 and Oracle NetSuite to permanently flag vendor with deletion indicator; enhance watchlist screening protocols to prevent future exposure

plan.expected_impact: Eliminate USD 64,508 in annual sanctions-exposed spend and mitigate regulatory penalty risk estimated at 2-10x spend exposure.
kpis: Days to complete OFAC validation and supplier block (target: 3 days)
USD spend transitioned away from sanctioned supplier (target: USD 64,508)
Number of qualified alternative suppliers onboarded (target: 2 minimum)
Percentage of open POs cancelled or fulfilled without compliance breach (target: 100%)
Time to full supplier exit and master data cleanup (target: 8 weeks)
risks: Supply disruption to 4 plants if alternative packaging suppliers cannot be secured within 4-6 weeks
OFAC penalties ranging from USD 129,016 to USD 645,080 if transactions continue during investigation period
False positive match could delay legitimate business if compliance review extends beyond 72 hours
Alternative suppliers may demand 10-20% premium pricing for expedited onboarding and lower volumes
Residual compliance exposure if open invoices or inventory receipts are paid post-blocking
erp_actions: SAP ECC 6.0: Set posting block in LFA1 (central) and LFB1 (company code) for Schwaben Packaging GmbH vendor master
SAP ECC 6.0: Set deletion flag and block vendor in all purchasing organizations (XK05)
Oracle NetSuite: Change vendor status to Inactive and add record-level restriction to prevent new transactions
SAP ECC 6.0: Remove all source list entries (ME01) for Schwaben Packaging across 4 plants
Oracle NetSuite and SAP ECC 6.0: Add mandatory compliance flag in vendor master custom field noting OFAC SDN match
SAP ECC 6.0: Block automatic payments (FBZP) and set payment block indicator in vendor master
Coupa: Deactivate supplier in supplier network and block supplier record from requisitioning
All ERPs: Implement enhanced watchlist screening workflow requiring dual compliance approval for any supplier reactivation
